name: WaveFunctionCollapse (WFC) procedural pattern synthesis
description: Verify sampling a canvas pattern, configuring WFC constraint solver parameters (N=2 or N=3), and synthesizing a seamless tileable pattern onto a dedicated WFC layer.

planSteps.description: Select the Rectangle tool and draw a textured 8x8 checker pattern in the center of the canvas
Click the 'PixiBud AI' tab button in the right inspector panel
Verify the 'WFC Pattern Synthesis' panel is displayed with neighborhood constraint settings
Click the 'Extend Pattern (WFC)' button (or Synthesize WFC Pattern)
Verify a dedicated 'WFC Synthesis' layer is generated containing a tileable procedural pattern obeying local pixel adjacency constraints
